character.name: Deniz
character.current_goal: Build the most defensible public account of a neighborhood marker whose map, oral history and inscription disagree.
established_knowledge: PUBLIC_ARCHIVE, MARKER_SQUARE and MAP_ROOM are explored.
SEALED_CABINET is discovered but unavailable under current archive rules.
Deniz may compare public maps, recorded oral history, municipal notes and the present inscription.
prohibited_knowledge: Deniz does not know the contents of SEALED_CABINET.
Deniz does not know whether one physical marker survived every redevelopment unchanged.
Deniz cannot treat remembered testimony as identical to a dated municipal record.

local_areas.summary: Reading room with cataloged public documents and oral-history recordings.
Present-day square containing the familiar marker and inscription.
Public room with historical map reproductions.
Unavailable cabinet referenced by an old catalog note; contents are not accessible.

current_facts: An old map uses one name for the site.
A recorded memory uses a different local name and emphasizes a different function.
The present inscription gives a concise commemorative account.
Municipal redevelopment notes confirm at least one physical change to the square.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: No canonical source proves that one account is wholly correct.
SEALED_CABINET contents are unknown and cannot resolve the story.

opportunity.title: Clarify the story behind the marker
opportunity.premise: Deniz can compare map evidence, remembered testimony, the inscription and present-day physical details without forcing them into one false certainty.
opportunity.success_condition: Produce a bounded preferred account that labels what is known, inferred, remembered and unresolved, and leave one evidence-based future question.
constraints: Use at least three distinct sources.
At least two sources must meaningfully disagree.
Preserve uncertainty instead of inventing a perfect chronology.

hard_rules: Historical evidence retains source type and uncertainty.
RUMORED or unavailable records are not evidence.
No omniscient reveal resolves every gap.
Character knowledge must stay within accessed sources.

eligible_context: Deniz is building a practice of preserving source disagreement rather than smoothing it away.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal SEALED_CABINET contents or invent a definitive hidden record.

relevant_memories.summary: Deniz previously corrected a local-history caption after noticing that a later summary had merged two separate events.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports the protagonist's current reasoning without revealing the answer.
